summary: Mapped the Pi SDK (pi-coding-agent 0.85.1) extension + session surface from .d.ts typings, docs, and examples. Findings: (1) ExtensionAPI is registration/lifecycle-only and exposes NO way to get the host AgentSession directly — only a read-only SessionManager via ctx; (2) the extension can construct independent AgentSession instances in-process via createAgentSession(), or drive raw model calls via ModelRuntime.stream/complete; (3) there is NO built-in subagent/task/delegation facility anywhere in dist typings — the shipped 'subagent' example spawns the `pi` CLI as a child process; (4) host discovery for a session is disabled via DefaultResourceLoaderOptions.noExtensions/noSkills/noPromptTemplates/noThemes/noContextFiles.

files.description: ExtensionAPI (line 906), ExtensionContext (:209), ExtensionCommandContext (:254), ToolDefinition (:344), RegisteredCommand (:891), all lifecycle events and UI context.
CreateAgentSessionOptions (:10) and createAgentSession() (:107) — the primary in-process session factory.
ModelRuntime (:35) — async model registry, auth, and stream/complete/streamSimple; the host-managed request path.
ResourceLoader (:29) and DefaultResourceLoaderOptions (:67) — system prompt override/append and the noExtensions/noSkills/noPromptTemplates/noThemes/noContextFiles discovery switches.

architecture: Two distinct execution paths exist. (A) Host-owned session: the host builds an AgentSession from CreateAgentSessionOptions (model runtime + ResourceLoader + SessionManager + SettingsManager + tool allowlist); extensions attach to it only through event hooks and a read-only SessionManager, and commands run inside that session's lifecycle. (B) Extension-owned sessions: an extension can call createAgentSession() N times to get fully independent AgentSession objects (each with its own Agent, transcript, and event stream), sharing one ModelRuntime for auth/model resolution — this is the supported way to run concurrent planner/researcher/synthesizer calls in one process. A third, lower-level path is calling modelRuntime.stream()/complete() directly with a Context {systemPrompt, messages, tools} for stateless single-shot model calls without an agent loop. There is no SDK-level orchestration/subagent primitive: delegation is implemented by either creating multiple AgentSessions or spawning the `pi` subprocess (see examples/extensions/subagent).

=====================================================================
5) SUBAGENT / TASK / DELEGATION FACILITY
=====================================================================
NONE built in. Checked: grep `subagent|Subagent|delegate|spawnAgent|ChildSession|childSession` across SDK/dist/**/*.d.ts returned only doc comments like "Override these to delegate command execution to remote systems (for example SSH)" in core/tools/{bash,edit,find,grep,ls,read,write}.d.ts — no type/class/function. `createAgentSession`/`AgentSession` expose no child-session API.
- docs/usage.md:309: pi "intentionally does not include built-in MCP, sub-agents, permission popups, plan mode, to-dos, or background bash."
- Only shipped delegation is an EXAMPLE: SDK/examples/extensions/subagent/ — a tool that spawns a separate `pi` child process via `node:child_process` with args `["--mode","json","-p","--no-session", ...]`, parses JSONL events (`message_end`, `tool_result_end`) from stdout, supports single/parallel/chain modes with MAX_PARALLEL_TASKS=8, MAX_CONCURRENCY=4, propagates AbortSignal by killing the child (index.ts:8-20, :300-420).
So: in-process delegate = create N AgentSessions yourself; process-isolated = spawn `pi --mode json -p`. No `Task` tool or agent-of-agents type.

=====================================================================
9) CONCURRENT / BATCH REQUESTS
=====================================================================
No SDK-level batch API, request queue, or global rate-limit governor (nothing in dist typings; queue matches are only SteeringQueue/FollowUpQueue for message delivery).
What exists:
- Tool-call parallelism: agent-loop default `toolExecution: "parallel"` — sibling tool calls preflighted sequentially then executed concurrently (PI_AGENT types.d.ts:22, :232; docs/extensions.md:655-658, :784).
- Per-request retry/backoff inside provider adapters: `retryProviderRequest(...)` honoring Retry-After and 408/409/429/5xx; options maxRetries, maxRetryDelayMs, signal (PI_AI/dist/api/*.js; google-shared.d.ts:74-82). Agent-turn auto-retry is separate (auto_retry_* events; RetrySettings in settings-manager.d.ts:17-22).
- Fan-out is user-implemented: create N AgentSessions (or N model calls) with your own concurrency cap — subagent's `mapWithConcurrencyLimit` with MAX_CONCURRENCY=4 is the reference (examples/extensions/subagent/index.ts:5-6, :220-240).

=====================================================================
10) TOOL LOOP SEMANTICS
=====================================================================
- Loop lives in @earendil-works/pi-agent-core (`agentLoop`/`runAgentLoop`, agent-loop.d.ts). Outer `while (true)` for follow-ups + inner `while (hasMoreToolCalls || pendingMessages.length > 0)` (agent-loop.js:84-88).
- MAX ITERATIONS: none. Grep for `maxIterations|maxTurns|maxSteps` across PI_AGENT/dist/**/*.d.ts returned NO option; the loop is unbounded and terminates on no-more-tool-calls / early-termination / abort.
- Abort: Agent.abort() (agent.d.ts), AgentSession.abort() (agent-session.d.ts:444), ctx.abort() (types.d.ts:1301), and AbortSignal passed to tools/streams (options.signal, execute(..., signal, ...)).
- Tool result feedback: toolcall_end → execute → AgentToolResult → tool_result/tool_execution_end events → toolResult message appended to context → next LLM call (docs/sdk.md:249-333). ToolResultEventResult can replace content/details/isError/usage; terminate:true on every finalized batch result stops after that batch (PI_AGENT types.d.ts:317-331).
- Loop control hooks on AgentLoopConfig (PI_AGENT types.d.ts:~180-260) / AgentOptions (agent.d.ts): shouldStopAfterTurn(context): boolean, prepareNextTurn(context), getSteeringMessages(), getFollowUpMessages(), beforeToolCall ({block:true}), afterToolCall (override), toolExecution.
- Extension running its own loop: (a) call session.prompt() repeatedly; (b) construct your own Agent and drive prompt()/continue() with custom hooks; (c) skip the agent and call modelRuntime.complete()/stream() per request in a loop you control (planner → N researchers in parallel → synthesizer). (c) is the cleanest fit for pi-discover.

=====================================================================
IMPLICATIONS FOR THE pi-discover REWRITE
=====================================================================
- Extension can own orchestration: `ModelRuntime.create()` once (or reuse host context), then per role `modelRuntime.complete(model, {systemPrompt, messages, tools?}, {signal, ...})` — stateless and concurrent; auth handled by the host if you reuse the host ModelRuntime. No AgentSession needed when roles don't need tool loops.
- If roles need tools/sessions: `createAgentSession({modelRuntime, model, resourceLoader, tools, customTools, sessionManager: SessionManager.inMemory(), settingsManager: SettingsManager.inMemory(...)})` per role; run with Promise.all + your own concurrency cap (e.g. 4).
- Isolate each role's prompt/discovery: `new DefaultResourceLoader({cwd, agentDir, noExtensions:true, noSkills:true, noPromptTemplates:true, noThemes:true, noContextFiles:true, systemPrompt: ROLE_PROMPT, appendSystemPromptOverride: () => []})` then `await loader.reload()`.
- Only ONE command (`/discover`) is needed; the concurrent planner/researcher/synthesizer calls live in its handler, not in registered model tools.
- Emit progress via ctx.ui.setStatus/setWidget/notify; write the final Markdown note from the handler with plain Node fs (optionally withFileMutationQueue).
